mutations.because: If the identity fingerprint reads the live `brief.id` instead of `identityKey ?? request.brief.id`, a re-slug of a not-yet-saved draft (a new `brief` reference with a different id) changes the identity and blanks the painted frame. The hook-level regression (usePreviewFrame with a stable identityKey, brief id 's' → 'summer') pins that the frame survives the re-slug; it fails when identity keys on the live slug.
